video_title: The Fire Blocking Rule Most DIYers Miss | Basement Finish Before & After | The Quilt House
assessment: A small basement finish: family room, bedroom with a walk in closet, and a full bath. The body leans on a fire blocking lesson over the framing, which is the long video's hook, so the Short leads on the detail Mike gives in the bathroom at 4:26: the homeowner's sister, whose basement Mike also finished (the Reading Nook House), has the same subway tile on her floor and around her tub. Finished footage is short, 3:24 to 5:46, and the family room is mostly white walls, so the Short runs about 45 seconds of tour plus the end card rather than padding out to 55.

shorts.full_vo: Two sisters, two basements, and both of them got the same tile. We used the subway tile in a way you do not see very often. This basement started out as nothing but bare framing. Now it has a family room, a bedroom, and a full bathroom. We hung their TV on the wall, and it is all one tone of white. The floor is the AquaGuard floor we always use. The bedroom has a walk in closet with built in shelves. It is on the floor and around the tub, the same as her sister's bathroom. Black fixtures, and a four foot vanity in a really dark gray. And open shelves for the linens and towels. An unfinished basement, now finished and ready to move in.
shorts.voice_direction: Warm and unhurried, a contractor quietly pleased that the two sisters ended up with matching bathrooms.
